summary: Final backend retest of the 3 HIGH multi-site issues and the minor items. test_jan2026_multisite_write_guards.py now has 24 tests: the original 21 plus 3 new ones for GET /staffing/conflicts and POST /shifts/bulk. All 24 pass. (a) The manager's workforce-dashboard open_shifts has no Site B open shift, and the owner still sees it. (b) Dashboard compliance.top and GET /staffing/conflicts, using 2 overlapping Site B shifts for deptdemo-sales-b, show no Site B staff to the manager. The owner still sees the conflict. (c) As the manager, PATCH of a Site A shift with site_id=iso-demo-site-b returns 403. (d) As the manager, POST /shifts/bulk with site_id=iso-demo-site-b returns 403. Without site_id it copies only the Site A shift, and no Site B shift is cloned. (e) As the manager, POST /hr/documents for Site B staff returns 403. Regression: the 4 requested files pass (94/94).

minor.issue: Code review: when a site lock applies, the filter is site_id $in locked. This silently skips Site A shifts that have no site_id (they are not cloned or counted). Consider $in locked + [None, ''].
Code review, unchanged: staff_docs and the clash pool are still read org-wide.
